title: Cargo Clockwork ambush
summary: Follow the Cargo Clockwork to the ambush on its delivery route.
overview: Follow the Cargo Clockwork to the ambush on its delivery route.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Stay with the clockwork and prepare for the three-enemy ambush.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The delivery trigger starts the clockwork's path and establishes a two-hour event lock.
At the ambush waypoint, Hector, Renaldo and Jerald appear around the stopped clockwork.
The route later returns the clockwork to its start; its death signals cleanup to the three ambushers.

notes: Approval E313. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
